info.title: Forcelink Partner Integration API - Momentum Dashboard POC
info.description:
Scoped, read-only partner API surface prepared for the Momentum dashboard proof-of-concept, covering time & attendance, proof-of-service (completed work orders), stock management, resource lookup, escalations, QR-code customer feedback, and cleaner tracking (NFC / beacon).

## Scope notes (per use-case responses received 2026-09-10)

- **Time & attendance**: clock in/out timestamps, late/absent flag, and leave status only, at employee-id + site (org unit) granularity, per shift/day. No real-time/live status in this POC.
- **Proof of service**: completed work orders only, grouped by site. SLA status/breach-flag calculation is explicitly out of scope for this exercise and will be specified at a later stage - this surface returns raw work-order and timestamp data only. `createdDate` is included so completion time (`completedDate - createdDate`) can be derived.
- **Stock management**: on-hand quantities and stock movements/transactions, grouped by store, with both current and historical data. Reorder thresholds are not included.

## Additions (per dashboard feedback, 2026-10)

- **Resources**: lookup of the resources referenced by `employeeId` / `resourceId` elsewhere, with role (`CLEANER`, `SUPERVISOR`, `SITE_MANAGER`) and `supervisorId` for the reporting line.
- **Escalations**: escalations raised from QR feedback, by supervisors, or by client request, with priority, escalation level, assignee and created / acknowledged / resolved timestamps.
- **Customer feedback (Prestige Pulse QR codes)**: individual QR-code submissions per location with a 1-5 rating, category and optional comment.
- **Cleaner tracking**: NFC tag scans and BLE beacon check-ins per cleaner and location. Beacon rows carry a check-out timestamp (dwell); NFC rows are point-in-time scans.
- **Deferred**: excluding the areas covered by the Chi POC (to avoid duplicated QR / cleaner tracking dashboards) is not modelled yet - all sites return full data.

## Auth

API-key auth via the `X-Api-Key` header (see `apiKeyAuth` security scheme). A dedicated UAT key, scoped to read-only access and to the specific sites agreed with Momentum, will be issued separately once this spec is confirmed.

## Pagination

All endpoints here return list payloads and are paginated via `page` / `per_page` query parameters, consistent with the core API.

get.summary: Per-shift attendance records for a date range.
get.description: Returns one record per employee per shift/day within the requested range: clock in/out timestamps, a derived late/absent flag, and leave status. Grouped by `employeeId` + `orgUnit` (site) as agreed with Momentum. No real-time/live status - this is a per-shift/day batch view.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range (ISO-8601 date, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the date range (ISO-8601 date, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Maximum span per request is 92 days.

parameters.name: orgUnitId
parameters.description: Filter to a single site. `orgUnit.type` is `SITE` for every value this endpoint accepts; omit to return all sites the API key is scoped to.

parameters.name: employeeId
parameters.description: Filter to a single employee/resource. Omit to return all employees at the requested site(s).

get.summary: Completed work orders for a date range, by site.
get.description: Returns work orders with status COMPLETED within the requested date range, grouped by site. Serves as proof-of-service for the POC. SLA status / breach-flag fields are intentionally not included - that calculation is out of scope for this exercise and will be spec'd at a later stage.

parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range (ISO-8601 date, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.description: Inclusive end of the date range (ISO-8601 date, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Maximum span per request is 92 days.

parameters.name: orgUnitId
parameters.description: Filter to a single site. `orgUnit.type` is `SITE` for every value this endpoint accepts; omit to return all sites the API key is scoped to.

get.summary: Current on-hand stock quantities, by store.
get.description: Returns current on-hand quantity per material, grouped by store.

parameters.name: storeId
parameters.description: Filter to a single store. Omit to return all stores the API key is scoped to.

200.description: Page of current on-hand stock rows.

get.summary: Stock movements/transactions for a date range, by store.
get.description: Returns stock movement/transaction history (receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments), grouped by store. Supports both current and historical queries - pass any `dateFrom`/`dateTo` range.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range (ISO-8601 date, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the date range (ISO-8601 date, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Maximum span per request is 92 days.

parameters.name: storeId
parameters.description: Filter to a single store. Omit to return all stores the API key is scoped to.

get.summary: Resource (employee / user) lookup, including supervisor hierarchy.
get.description: Returns the resources (cleaners, supervisors, site managers) at the sites the API key is scoped to. Use it to resolve the resource ids returned by the other endpoints, and `supervisorId` to roll cleaner metrics up to their supervisor. Not date-ranged.

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: Return a single resource.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Filter by role.

get.description: Returns escalations whose `createdDate` falls in the requested range. Response times are derived from `createdDate`, `acknowledgedDate` and `resolvedDate`.

get.description: Returns NFC scans and beacon check-ins whose `checkInTimestamp` falls in the requested range. Check-ins only occur while the cleaner is clocked in (see `/attendance/shift-records`).

ApiEnvelopeBase.description: Shared response shell for every partner-integration endpoint. Mirrors the envelope used by the core Forcelink v1 API so downstream consumers only need to learn one shape.

data.description: Payload on success. Null on error.

Pagination.description: Present on every endpoint in this spec (all are list endpoints). Follows the same shape as the core Forcelink v1 API.

orgUnit.description: The site the shift is planned against.

shiftDate.description: Calendar date the shift falls on (per-shift/day granularity, not a live feed).

clockInTimestamp.description: Null if the employee never clocked in for this shift.

status.description: Derived attendance flag for the shift.

leaveStatus.description: `NONE` unless a leave request overlaps this date.

status.description: Fixed to COMPLETED for this exercise; SLA-status and breach-flag fields are out of scope for the POC and will be spec'd separately.

createdDate.description: When the work order was created/logged. Completion time = `completedDate - createdDate`.

resourceId.description: Resource (cleaner) who closed the work order, if assigned. Resolve via `/resources`.

asOfTimestamp.description: When this on-hand snapshot was taken.

quantity.description: Signed where relevant (e.g. negative for ISSUE).

referenceDocument.description: Linked work order code or purchase-order/GRN number, where applicable.

resourceId.description: Forcelink resource id. Same id space as `employeeId` (attendance), `resourceId` (work orders, check-ins) and the escalation resource fields.

supervisorId.description: Resource id of this resource's supervisor (cleaner -> supervisor, supervisor -> site manager). Null for site managers.

active.description: False once the resource has left / been deactivated.

location.description: Area within the site where the QR code / NFC tag / beacon is installed.

feedbackId.description: QR feedback submission that triggered this escalation (source `QR_FEEDBACK` only).

workOrderId.description: Reactive work order raised to action the escalation, if any.

level.description: Escalation level: 1 = supervisor, 2 = supervisor (escalated, open > 4h), 3 = site manager (open > 24h).

raisedByResourceId.description: Resource who raised it (source `SUPERVISOR`); null for customer / client-raised escalations.

assignedToResourceId.description: Supervisor or site manager the escalation is assigned to.

location.description: Area within the site where the QR code / NFC tag / beacon is installed.

submittedTimestamp.description: When the QR form was submitted.

escalationId.description: Escalation raised from this submission, if any.

location.description: Area within the site where the QR code / NFC tag / beacon is installed.

checkInTimestamp.description: NFC scan time, or beacon entry time.

checkOutTimestamp.description: Beacon exit time (dwell). Always null for NFC scans.

Page.name: page
Page.description: 1-indexed page number. Defaults to the first page.

Forbidden.description: API key is valid but not scoped to the requested site/store.

example.message: API key is not scoped to this site.

error.message: API key is not scoped to this site.

ValidationError.description: A required parameter was missing or malformed (e.g. `dateFrom` after `dateTo`, or a range exceeding 92 days).

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this API key.

apiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Static API key issued per integration partner, scoped to specific sites/stores and to read-only access on the endpoints in this spec. Distinct from the session-cookie auth used by the internal Forcelink v1 API; this key is not valid against `/forcelink/rest/v1/*`.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token for testing with mock API.
